title: The cooking club
instructions: Bir kadın mahalledeki yemek kulübü hakkında bilgi alıyor. Gün, saat, fiyat ve gerekenleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Hello. I want some information about the cooking club.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Sure. It's every Thursday evening, from six to eight.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Every Thursday? I work late on the first Thursday of the month.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: That's OK. You can come on the other Thursdays.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's five pounds a week, or eighteen pounds for a month.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: What do I need to bring?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Just an apron and a box to take your food home. We buy all the food.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Food from different countries. Next week is Indian food.
